result.summary: This scripted-diff PR adds `#include <util/check.h>` across test, bench, and fuzz harnesses where assertions are used, while removing now-redundant `<cassert>` includes. It also updates CI lint setup to enable `clang-format` in scripted diffs and formats the resulting includes.
result.problem: In test code, direct usage of `assert` creates ambiguity regarding whether `NDEBUG` could disable checks or whether `Assert` should be used instead. Missing direct includes also complicate tooling like Include What You Use (IWYU).
